Synopsis:
    A 43-year-old Swiss man carried out a lone-perpetrator shooting at a rave party in Aarau, Switzerland, killing one Italian woman and injuring six others. He fired 40+ shots indiscriminately before turning himself in at a police station. Three weapons were recovered. Authorities found no ideological or extremist motive; mental health issues are suspected.
